typography.instructions: Use Unbounded for H1-H4 headings with tight tracking for a premium gaming/tech feel. Use IBM Plex Sans for legible body text. Use JetBrains Mono for the large stopwatch timer digits.

colors.instructions: Use neon red (#FF2A2A) sparingly as the key accent for CTAs, active states, and live indicators. Base layout must be deep void black (#050505) and charcoal. Never use generic dark grey.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10) for headers. Never use fully transparent headers. Use Tracing Beam effect for active Challenge Slots.
visual_enhancers.effects: Neon glows on hover. 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layouts.grid: High Density Grid for the dashboard and room lists. Bento Grid for the marketing/home page. Mobile-first layout.

motion.guidelines: Use framer-motion for the large animated stopwatch (scale, blur effects). Micro-interactions on all buttons. Staggered entrance animations for multiplayer room lists. Avoid universal `transition: all`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over red or dark backgrounds meets APCA contrast ratios. Use text-shadow if needed.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='stopwatch-stop-button').

components.rules: Use Shadcn/UI for tables, forms, dialogues. Go cardless or use sharp edges for dashboards. DO NOT use generic card wrappers for marketing sections.

images.description: Person sitting on gaming chair playing video game - perfect for hero section background with overlay.
Soccer field at night with stadium lights - use for room thumbnails or ambient background.
Person using computer playing FPS game.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion instead of 3D libraries. 2D precision is critical for a stopwatch. Add visual depth using SVG animated circular progress bars with drop-shadow glows to simulate a premium HUD.
3d_libraries.instructions: Combine framer-motion for number counting and smooth scaling, and requestAnimationFrame for high-performance stopwatch state.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In tailwind.config.js, update colors to set primary accent to neon red (#FF2A2A) and dark mode base to void black (#050505).
2. Add fonts Unbounded, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.html.
3. Delete App.css content that centers everything, especially `.App-header` styles. It ruins layout.

4. The main visual is the LARGE STOPWATCH. Make it enormous, center it visually within its container (not whole page text-center), use JetBrains Mono, and add a subtle red text-shadow glow when running.
5. Use Shadcn components for Wallet, Admin Panel, and Tables. Ensure all Shadcn components are created as .js files, not .tsx.
6. Build a custom Grid/Bento layout for the Home Marketing page, using the provided images with bg-black/50 overlay.
7. Implement strict testing attributes (data-testid) on all buttons, forms, and the main stopwatch.
8. Use Framer Motion for room cards entering the viewport and the countdown before game starts.
